task.prompt: Build an in-memory order management core in this repository. Work autonomously: set up the project, plan briefly if useful, write the code, add tests, and run the configured validation command. Create a TypeScript npm project with npm test and npm run build scripts. Implement an OrderStore backed only by local in-memory state (for example a Map): createOrder(customerId) returns a unique pending order with no items; addItem(orderId, sku, unitPrice, quantity) adds or increases a line item; removeItem removes a line item; orderTotal returns the sum of unitPrice * quantity; updateStatus permits pending -> paid -> fulfilled and cancellation from pending or paid; and listOrders(status?) returns all or matching orders. Quantity must be a positive integer, unitPrice non-negative, unknown IDs rejected, and fulfilled/cancelled orders immutable, all with clear typed errors. Keep domain logic testable without a UI. package.json must declare a main, module, or exports entry point resolving to a built file that exports a class named OrderStore constructible with new OrderStore(). Do not ask for clarification; use sensible defaults and complete the feature.

execution.instructions: You are in a controlled benchmark. Work only in the supplied task workspace. Implement, test, and repair the requested feature; do not access network services or use unrelated tools.

rounds.prompt: Review the implementation against the task specification. Exercise the OrderStore and repair every issue you find: order totals must merge duplicate SKUs; invalid quantity and unitPrice must not corrupt state; legal and illegal status transitions must behave as specified; terminal orders must reject mutation; filtering must be exact; and unknown ids must raise typed errors. Add focused tests for every repaired behavior, run the configured validation command, and leave the workspace passing.

Perform a final benchmark handoff: inspect the diff, run all configured tests and the production build, repair failures, and briefly state what was implemented and what validation ran. Do not add unrelated features.
